profile.headline: Software Engineer at Travelers
profile.summary: I am a CCSU graduate, looking to obtain a position in software engineering or cybersecurity. By increasing my understanding in the field of computer science, I will have the ability to help companies improve their software network and prevent attacks to their websites, applications, and programs.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Audited client charges, resulting in the discovery of tens of thousands of dollars in monthly billing discrepancies, through the use of Python to collect, clean, analyze, and present invoice details.
Collaborated with colleagues to write a script, enhancing searching functionality of large datasets by applying data structures and search algorithms, thereby increasing workplace efficiency.
Provided multiple clients with valuable information regarding their SD-WAN network configuration through the use of REST APIs and Python.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Data Analysis · Data Structures · React.js · Algorithms · Communication · Teamwork · Networking · Postman API · REST APIs

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Developed software that enabled the research of market metrics, allowing for purchases surpassing 1,000 merchandise items with the highest possible return on investment, implementing Node.js.
Coordinated with businesses and consumers to sell inventory in excess of $700,000 in revenue while building strong communication skills and displaying an eagerness to maintain mutual partnerships.
Operated and grew a business independently over the years, measured through consistent performance improvements, optimizing time management, and taking accountability for success and challenges.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Customer Service · Networking · Communication · Business Development · Market Research

positions.title: Network Support Engineer
positions.description:
Optimized user experience with servers and proxies, deploying updates via automation scripts.
Guaranteed excellent customer satisfaction, resolving over 1,400 requests by clarifying the problems, sharing steps to resolve the concerns, and delivering timely resolutions that please the clients.
Reduced downtime of proxies by testing them frequently and ensuring proper usage.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Support · Customer Service · Leadership · Teamwork · Server Management

positions.title: Advanced Support Technician
positions.description:
Investigated hardware- and software-related issues in-person and virtually for 2,000+ campus members.
Trained and assisted new employees in the process of receiving, rectifying, and recording cases.
Provided solutions and guidance for faculty, staff and students using Microsoft Office products.
Communicated resolutions of inquiries to clients and how the problem may be prevented in the future.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Support · Hardware Support · Software Support · Customer Service · Communication · Networking · Leadership

company.name: University of Connecticut Information Technology Services

projects.title: AI in Workforce Knowledge Capture and Transfer
projects.description:
Lead the integration of a LLM video analysis program, facilitating the insertion of key frames into work instructions as part of a team of four, following a Scrum framework and dividing responsibilities.
Design and executing a robust application, fulfilling evolving criteria determined by a professor, identifying short-term goals, and accomplishing them within established timelines.
Detail the full procedure from project inception to completion, documenting code, producing user guides, and conveying technical information orally and in writing to non-expert audiences.
